stages.name: Brief
stages.entry: Owner direction naming a physical decision, or a discovery shortlist entry.
stages.exit: A one-page brief naming the buyer role, the decision and the value at stake, with sources or labelled assumptions.
stages.owner_basis: discovery/README.md (CHALLENGE-DISCOVERY-01 is research and recommendation only); Eight_Challenge_Foundation_Plan.md section 4 holds the eight briefs
stages.note: Selecting a Challenge stays the owner's; nothing here admits one.

stages.name: Design packet
stages.exit: The ten sections of COMMON_DESIGN_PACKET_V1 filled with source-linked facts; every value without an owner decision or evidence is OPEN with owner, needed decision and held-closed behavior.
stages.owner_basis: Branch names in the packet commits (codex/*) and the value-cost framework; the packet template names no session
stages.note: The owner-session mapping is UNVERIFIED; the sections and exit are verified.

stages.name: Solver package
stages.entry: A packet whose reference route needs a package that is not yet built.
stages.exit: A pinned reference package with an accepted image and manifest identity, measured per-case cost and memory, and conservation checks within packet tolerances.
stages.owner_basis: solver-package-specs/README.md is titled as a DC build handoff; value-cost Part C is 'Data Collection measures'
stages.note: The specs are SPECIFIED, not built or qualified; accepted identities are null.

stages.name: Feasibility and value panel
stages.entry: A reference route that can run, even if slowly.
stages.exit: Value criteria V1-V5, validity criteria T1-T5 and cost criteria C1 onward evidenced for the Challenge, with a keep, reframe or replace decision recorded.
stages.owner_session: Codex packets the value case; Data Collection measures; Test Lead judges; owner sets final thresholds
stages.owner_basis: value-cost/README.md part headings (V: packets Codex; T: Data Collection measures, Test Lead judges; C: Data Collection measures)
stages.note: Working values only; final thresholds are the owner's.

stages.name: Question law
stages.entry: A passing feasibility and value panel.
stages.exit: A non-runtime law sheet (population, action lattice, strata, near rule) whose HUMAN_INPUT values the owner has accepted or declined; the four-check design-value prerequisite met before any new hidden bank.
stages.owner_basis: question-laws/README.md: SPECIFIED, not an enforced runtime gate; accepted widths and criteria stay HUMAN_INPUT
stages.note: A law sheet registers no sampler and no exposure setting.

stages.name: Bank
stages.entry: An accepted question law and the design-value prerequisite.
stages.exit: A sealed hidden bank prepared on the hidden host from a pinned validator image, never on a host every agent session can read.
stages.owner_session: Carbon Validator (producer, bank adapters, VALIDATOR-28 family sources); Data Collection supplies each family's reference package and panel; the owner approves startup spend
stages.owner_basis: Test Lead ruling, 2026-10-10 (relayed to the Graphite Testing Manager); Bank architecture #756 and the hidden-pool runbook; register lessons S11 and S12 constrain where and how
stages.note: Owner session settled by the Test Lead ruling. Entry and exit are still assembled from the hidden-pool runbook and register lessons S11 and S12, not from one stage definition.

stages.name: Readiness gate
stages.entry: The Challenge wired in readiness/challenges.json for the level, and a main SHA that contains every PR the stage checklist names.
stages.exit: launch_ready true at that exact SHA: no FAIL, NOT_BUILT or REVIEW_REQUIRED; waivers are stage-bound and measurement-only; reports committed through PR Head.
stages.owner_session: Graphite Testing Manager runs; Test Lead reviews and waives
stages.note: A waiver is never a PASS and a review never turns a FAIL into one.

stages.name: Graphite stage A (L0 and L1)
stages.entry: The stage A checklist preconditions (section 1), the launch preflight green, and a launch_ready L0 gate.
stages.exit: The checklist runs complete with a lessons entry, evidence digest and spend count per run; L0 confirmations through the Launchpad; refused-capability extracts collected; stage report to the Test Lead.
stages.owner_session: Executor runs; Launchpad lanes; Test Engineer bindings; Test Lead decides
stages.note: Stage A is measurement only; L1 confirmations wait for an L1 Q1 report and VALIDATOR-25.

stages.name: Graphite stage B (L2 and L3 on the dev-ladder)
stages.entry: VALIDATOR-25 slices deployed; stage A closed; the owner's spend approval and a bound grant.
stages.exit: Per the stage B plan: runs complete with lessons entries and a stage summary.
stages.owner_session: Executor runs; Carbon Validator owns VALIDATOR-25; owner approves spend
stages.note: Stage B's grant files do not exist; its spend line is only prepared.

stages.name: Graphite stage C (L4, graph only)
stages.entry: Stage B prerequisites clear; Level 4 permission for the dev-ladder and the dev door only (granted); the owner's spend approval.
stages.exit: Per the wave plan section 4a: the stage C Constructor and Attacker runs complete with lessons entries.
stages.owner_session: Executor runs; Level 4 engineer owns the rebuild path; owner approves spend

stages.name: Tested Challenge
stages.entry: Graphite stages A to C closed for every enabled level, with their reports.
stages.exit: TESTED when ALL hold: (1) the readiness gate is launch_ready at every enabled level (no FAIL; waivers expired or closed); (2) a sealed hidden bank exists, with exposure accounting; (3) Graphite stages are complete at every enabled level, with real Launchpad confirmations scored by a validator, and every Attacker finding dispositioned (fixed, or accepted with a reason); (4) score-value alignment is measured on confirmed recipes (a Q1 report exists), and a negative result is allowed but must trigger a scoring iteration; (5) control detection (T3) meets its target at the chosen k and E; (6) the incentive canary shows the best model weighted (INCENTIVE-CANARY-01); (7) the stage-end report is filed.
stages.owner_basis: Test Lead working definition, development, 2026-10-10 (relayed to the Graphite Testing Manager); LESSONS_REGISTER.md rules and section 8
stages.note: A working definition for development, ruled by the Test Lead. TESTED is not scientific qualification, security acceptance, LIVE or a launch claim; LIVE or qualification is a separate owner step.
